source.file_name: Web banner basics - Web banner - Bosch Digital Design System.html

purpose.summary: Guidance for the design and programming of Bosch web banners, extending the Bosch UI Kit and supporting consistent web banner style across digital channels.
scope: Use of templates, libraries, and related design principles

core_guidance.rule: Treat this page as an extension of the Bosch UI Kit for the design and programming of web banners.
core_guidance.rationale: The guide exists to ensure a consistent style and appearance of web banners across digital channels.
core_guidance.evidence_quote: This is an extension of the Bosch UI Kit on the design and programming of web banners. The following style guide ensures a consistent style and appearance of web banners across all digital channels.

core_guidance.rule: Each product owner is responsible for checking legal and data-protection requirements in the relevant market.
core_guidance.evidence_quote: Each product owner is responsible for compliance with legal requirements in the respective market. These must be checked with the responsible legal department and the responsible data protection officer.

core_guidance.rule: Use Sketch for efficient Bosch web banner design when following this guide.
core_guidance.evidence_quote: To achieve an efficient design in web banners for Bosch, using Sketch is advised.

core_guidance.rule: Install and use the Web banner design template alongside the Core and Icon Overrides Library.
core_guidance.evidence_quote: the Sketch document Web banner design template is installed and used alongside the Core and Icon Overrides Library.

core_guidance.rule: Check for updates regularly to keep files current.
core_guidance.evidence_quote: updates are checked for on a regular basis to keep the files up to date.

core_guidance.rule: Refer to installation and library/template usage guidance under Start Designing.
core_guidance.evidence_quote: further information on the installation and use of libraries/templates is referred to. This can be found under Start Designing.

core_guidance.rule: Send feature requests and bug reports for the Digital Design System or Frontend Kit to the digital expert team via Jira; send design feedback/questions to support.design@bosch.com.
core_guidance.evidence_quote: Please submit all feature requests and bug reports relating to the Digital Design System or the Frontend Kit directly to the digital expert team via Jira.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.summary: Positions web banner basics as an extension of the Bosch UI Kit for design and programming, with the goal of consistent banner appearance across digital channels.

sections.title: Legal and data-protection responsibility
sections.summary: Product owners must check market-specific legal requirements with legal and data-protection contacts before implementation.

sections.title: Essentials at a glance
sections.summary: Provides quick access to downloadable resources, design principles, templates, and animation principles.

sections.title: Additional instructions
sections.summary: Recommends Sketch and specifies required libraries/templates, update hygiene, and references for Start Designing guidance.

sections.title: Support and feedback
sections.summary: Routes feature requests and bugs through Jira and provides the design support email for feedback, questions, and draft checks.

extracted_visible_text_blocks.text: This is an extension of the Bosch UI Kit on the design and programming of web banners. The following style guide ensures a consistent style and appearance of web banners across all digital channels.

Info! Each product owner is responsible for compliance with legal requirements in the respective market. These must be checked with the responsible legal department and the responsible data protection officer. Contacts for legal topics can be found via Find Your Lawyer , contacts for data protection via the Bosch Portal .
To achieve an efficient design in web banners for Bosch, using Sketch is advised. For this purpose, Sketch libraries are utilized. When using these supplied libraries, please ensure that
the Sketch document Web banner design template is installed and used alongside the Core and Icon Overrides Library.
updates are checked for on a regular basis to keep the files up to date.
further information on the installation and use of libraries/templates is referred to. This can be found under Start Designing .

Please submit all feature requests and bug reports relating to the Digital Design System or the Frontend Kit directly to the digital expert team via Jira. You can learn more about how the process works, here .
If you have any feedback or questions about designing digital touchpoints, feel free to send them to support.design@bosch.com . We’re also happy to check design drafts.
